children: VisionWave Holdings was prequalified by the Liberia Petroleum Regulatory Authority and invited to enter direct negotiations for a Production Sharing Contract.
LPRA approved VisionWave Holdings' prequalification after independent due diligence and invited it to negotiate a PSC.
The invitation names no blocks, terms, exclusivity or rights and does not create any entitlement to Liberian resources.
Outstanding items—technical arrangements, financial capacity verification, and ESG readiness—must be resolved during negotiations.
Any PSC would require substantial capital, regulatory approvals in Liberia, and could be dilutive; no negotiations have yet commenced.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: VisionWave Holdings invited to direct PSC negotiations by Liberia regulator after prequalification
